dek: The Transport Department (TD) today (August 19) said that the next online auction of vehicle registration marks (VRMs) will be held from noon on September 3 (Thursday) to noon on September 7 (Monday) through the auction platform E-Auction ( e-auction.td.gov.hk ). Interested bidders can participate in the online auction
